approved_task_config.title: An interior control cannot exactly desensitize every heat-shape functional when observation fills the domain

standard_prerequisites.name: Classical Hadamard shape derivative for the heat functional
standard_prerequisites.statement: The derivative is the boundary integral of V·n times the time integral of ∂_n y_0∂_n z_0, with the displayed forward-backward system. The original source credits Lissy-Privat-Simpore Proposition1.1.

standard_prerequisites.name: Sobolev trace lifting and local heat regularity
standard_prerequisites.statement: On a smooth domain, compatible boundary traces through order3 lift to H^4; a heat solution with forcing supported away from the boundary has smooth boundary jets in the relevant compact time interval.

standard_prerequisites.name: Baire category and smooth roots of a positive function
standard_prerequisites.statement: On a positive-dimensional smooth compact manifold there exist C^4 functions nowhere C^5; a continuous branch of a quadratic with strictly positive smooth discriminant is smooth.

core_obligations: Choose boundary data with finite smoothness but nowhere one additional derivative, lift its four boundary traces to an H^4 interior function, and manufacture an L^2 forcing whose uncontrolled forward/adjoint pair has these traces.

Use interior support of every possible control to make its boundary contributions smooth, then reduce exact shape insensitivity to a quadratic equation for the rough boundary datum; its discriminant forces local or global smoothness and gives a contradiction.

proof_roadmap.step: Derive the quadratic boundary contradiction for every interior control.

approved_task_config.difficulty_reason: The obstruction is a designed boundary regularity mismatch, not a generic failure of controllability: four traces are synchronized so the shape response contains -g^2 plus smooth coefficients, which prevents cancellation by any interior control.

compared.difference: Public primary Theorem1.7/source390-393 proves simultaneous exact finite-dimensional and approximate all-direction control for disjoint interior observation. Here observation is all of Omega and the conclusion is a universal exact-control obstruction.
